---
title: Legend
---

```css
/* ----------------------------------------
    Legend
---------------------------------------- */
#legend {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  right: 0;
  z-index: 10;
  margin-top: 10px;
  margin-right: 10px;
  background: white;
  opacity: 0.95;
  border-radius: 5px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);
  padding: 5px 10px;
}

#legend p {
  margin: 10px 0 5px;
}

.legend-item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  margin: 5px 0;
}
```

## Add layer styles to legend

```css
/* ----------------------------------------
    Legend symbols (match with layer visualisation)
---------------------------------------- */
/* Forest reserve categories */
.forest-reserve {
  background: #006b00;
}

.forest-plantation {
  background: #d3f226;
}

.nature-reserve {
  background: #81bf00;
}

.village-reserve {
  background: #56cf68;
}
/* National parks layer */
.national-park {
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    45deg,
    #000000,
    #000000 1px,
    transparent 1px,
    transparent 7px
  );
  border: 1px solid #000000;
}

/* International conservation areas layer */
.international-area {
  background: repeating-linear-gradient(
    135deg,
    #000000,
    #000000 1px,
    transparent 1px,
    transparent 7px
  );
  border: 1px solid #000000;
}
```
